title: ComponentLine
description: One equipment family line and every generation of it — the machine-readable form of an equipment-catalog entry (equipment-conventions.md 7). The line owns the ladder: `common` holds what every generation shares, and each generation states ONLY what changes from the founding generation. Anything a generation does not restate carries forward from the founding generation and then from `common`. That carry-forward is the catalog's own law and tools/validate.py resolves it.

prefix.description: Two-letter nation prefix carried by every code in this line (conventions 1.1). Must agree with `nation`.

family.description: Three-letter family (conventions 1.1). Unlisted components are as-built for the hull year and get no line.

name.description: Display name of the line, e.g. 'Diesel engine cartridge' or '14 cm triple dual-purpose turret'.

band.description: This line's calibration band under equipment-conventions.md 8. interest = up to +5 years ahead of history; supporting = +2 to +3; par = at history; cold = behind history, deliberately. Architecture, process and interface choices may run deeper than +5 in ANY band; performance may not exceed +5 in any band, interest included, and a figure exceeding the best real article at any date in the window is licensed by no band at all. A line audited against the wrong band is the commonest false finding in this project, which is why the band is data and not prose.

designation.description: The navy's own designation for the founding generation, in that navy's system: Japan 'Type NN', USA 'Mark N', Britain 'Mark I-VI', Germany 'C/NN'. The code is the data; this is the display (conventions 1.2).

catalog_ref.description: Section number in the owning equipment catalog, e.g. 'jp-as-long-as-its-black-equipment-catalog.md 4.1'.

common.description: The `Common` row: specifications every generation in this line shares. Carried forward onto every generation at resolve time.

generations.description: In year order, founding generation first.

code.description: The SKU key, e.g. 'jp32eng'. Its two-digit year IS its availability date (conventions 5).

year.description: Must agree with the code's two digits, 19NN.

designation.description: This generation's own designation where it differs from the line's.

spec.description: ONLY what changes from the founding generation. Everything else carries forward.

line_ended.description: Year this generation ceased production, where the catalog states one.

mounts.description: Where the line can be carried, for lines fitted in more than one place (a cannon in an aircraft and on a ship's gallery, a rocket on wing-root rails and on ship rails).

rounds_per_barrel.description: Magazine capacity is a property of the MOUNT, not the gun: an aircraft twin firing from an integral magazine and a naval twin fed continuously from the ship carry the same weapon behind different feeds.

feed.description: How the mount is supplied — integral magazine, or continuous from the ship.

interface.description: The hull or airframe interface this line plugs into — must match a `provisions[].interface` value on any platform that carries it. This is the join that makes conventions 6's provision-match cost rule computable.
